name: craft
description: Improve existing SaaS interfaces without losing the product's identity. Preserve-first UI/UX evolution: diagnoses before it designs, makes the smallest sufficient change, and proves the result.

posture.title: Default change posture
posture.description: How much change CRAFT may make before asking. conservative | evolutionary | transformative

verification.title: Verification depth
verification.description: auto | checks | visual | browser | none. auto picks a level from the risk of each change.

questions_max.title: Maximum blocking questions per task
questions_max.description: CRAFT infers where it safely can and asks only when the answer changes the outcome.

research.title: External research
research.description: on-demand | never. Research is evidence, never doctrine, and never overrides your product's conventions.
